log.msg: Read ai-api.md, Page.class.js, Jsonl.js, LivePage.js, Previews.js. Key: LivePage.render() fully overrides Page's render, never calling PageFrame (tabs/columns/nav) or draw_folder() (place). So navigation/tabs/columns/place look architecturally dead on a LivePage subpage; need to confirm, and also test on plain Page. previews() is a method a page's own content() code must call explicitly - no delta invokes it, so it is not voice-drivable via the item tool regardless of class. Building /live/demos/ hub + one subpage per feature now.

Verdicts, proven live on /live/demos/ (plain Page vs LivePage sub-pages, class override via pages.add's `class`): tabs WORKS on plain Page ({"navigation":"tabs"}, Frame.js:19-20 -> ext/tabs), BROKEN on LivePage (LivePage.js render():145-157 never builds PageFrame). columns BROKEN both ways: Frame.js render():8-30 has no case for navigation==="columns" at all (page.columns() is a separate opt-in method a content() must call, Page.class.js:636 / Columns.js:55). place WORKS on a fresh plain Page with no own content() (Jsonl.js content():199-206 -> draw_folder() -> draw_placed, shows note.md + a red 'Not written yet' for a missing file), BROKEN on LivePage (LivePage.draw_cards():176-186 only draws this.cards, never calls log_draw()/draw_folder()). nav(rail) WORKS on plain Page (Frame.js:14 rail("left"), rows():79-94, real <a> links), BROKEN on LivePage same reason as tabs. previews BROKEN entirely: no delta reaches it (Page.callable has only tab/place, Page.WORDS has no previews) and calling {"previews":{}} directly is REFUSED, not ignored -- page_tools.js:905 replays every line in Node before writing, previews() builds DOM (div.c), throws 'document is not defined', write refused with 'this line would not replay'. Proven live, exact error text captured.

Built /live/demos/ hub + 10 sub-pages (5 LivePage class, 5 plain-Page class via pages.add's class override) via the item tool only. Shots (this task dir, C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-2 does not hold them -- they're PNGs in %TEMP%, paths below) confirm each verdict. Wrote public/live/doc/page-features.md (table + per-feature file:line cause + smallest fix) and linked it from public/live/readme.md under 'Going into a thing: sub-pages'. Committed 4d9f8d329 (public/live/ is gitignored as temporary 2026-10-19, so both files were git add -f'd deliberately -- the only exception to that ignore). No code changes made, per fence.

Correction: a page_set-style item call with a repo-relative `path` ("public/framework/...") doubled the prefix and wrote a stray public/public/.../page.jsonl tree in the main checkout. Deleted it immediately (untracked, nothing lost). Landing line follows via append.mjs instead.
